title: Anthropic may not secure investment-grade rating after IPO, Blackstone says
summary: Blackstone says Anthropic is expected to receive a 'high' junk credit rating after its IPO, a shift from earlier guidance that it might reach investment grade. Details are limited to the headline blurb.

title: Alphabet, matriz de Google, tuvo su mayor caída en bolsa: ¿es momento de comprar sus acciones?
summary: La caída de Alphabet en Wall Street, su mayor en bolsa, reabre el debate sobre si sus acciones son una oportunidad. La mayoría de los analistas mantiene una visión favorable pese al desplome.

title: US tech stocks tumble as earnings stoke AI spending fears
summary: US tech stocks fell as earnings stoked fears over AI spending. Intel is on track for its biggest one-day plunge since 1974 after its results spooked investors.

title: ‘Calaverita’ para el peso: Gana 3 centavos ante el dólar por posible aumento en tasas de la Fed
summary: El peso ganó tres centavos frente al dólar, pero las presiones cambiarias persisten porque el mercado espera otro aumento de tasas de la Fed este año.

title: Why Anthropic’s AI Edge Appeals to Long-Term Investors
summary: Baillie Gifford's Peter Singlehurst explains why Anthropic's technical expertise, innovation and efficient compute use appeal to long-term investors. He also views its governance structure, with seven founders holding voting control, as a positive.

title: AI to Drive 40% Growth for AWS: CEO Garman
summary: AWS CEO Matt Garman says the company aims to 'responsibly fund' its AI buildout to meet customer demand. AWS grew for a sixth straight quarter and could grow more than 40% yearly in each of the next two years.

title: CD&R pursues buyout of $40bn card processor Global Payments
summary: Private equity firm CD&R is pursuing a buyout of Global Payments, a $40bn card processor. The deal would rank among the largest buyouts in history.

title: Binance rushes to recover customer money after $6.3bn heist
summary: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, is rushing to recover customer funds after a $6.3bn heist. The company says an engineer's laptop was compromised in the breach.

title: Amazon Taps $80 Billion Supplier Loan Facility to Help Fund AI
summary: Amazon has set up supplier financing arrangements to borrow up to $80bn against the value of hardware it buys. The move preserves financial flexibility as it spends hundreds of billions on AI infrastructure.

title: Fed’s Musalem Says More Rate Hikes Needed Soon to Tame Inflation
summary: Fed's Alberto Musalem said additional rate increases are needed soon to bring inflation back to the central bank's target.

title: Binance’s $6.3 Billion Cyber Heist Shows Crypto Vulnerabilities
summary: Binance suffered the industry's biggest-ever hack, with $6.3bn in funds affected and $3bn frozen. The exchange says it will cover all losses and expects withdrawals to resume by Sunday.

title: Anthropic's S1 | Google's AI Problem | The Rundown
summary: Bloomberg Tech's rundown covers Anthropic's newly filed S-1 and a rough week for Google in AI. Based on the headline blurb only.

title: Economía de México supera expectativas: Crece 3.2% anual en tercer trimestre, el más alto en 3 años
summary: La economía de México creció 0.9% trimestral en julio-septiembre, su tercer avance consecutivo, y 3.2% anual, el mayor ritmo en tres años según la estimación oportuna del Inegi. El resultado superó expectativas pese a la incertidumbre comercial con EU.

title: El peso se debilita otra vez: el precio de dólar roza los MXN$19
summary: El dólar roza los 19 pesos (18.92 en spot), con una depreciación diaria de 0.3%, ante la incertidumbre sobre el diferencial de tasas entre México y otras economías.

title: Seis claves para entender por qué Intel se desploma casi 30% y Amazon cae tras sus resultados
summary: Intel shares fell almost 30% and Amazon also dropped after quarterly results, as both face doubts over capturing AI growth. Bloomberg Línea gives six keys to understanding the moves.

title: Explicador: ¿Qué pasará con el dinero de los clientes tras el hackeo a Binance?
summary: Binance suspendió retiros tras un ataque informático que sustrajo unos 6,300 millones de dólares el 29 de octubre. La empresa dice haber bloqueado una parte de los fondos; el explicador detalla qué pasará con el dinero de los clientes.

title: Did Anthropic value itself at $1.2tn in August?
summary: The FT questions whether Anthropic really valued itself at $1.2tn in August. Based on a one-line blurb only.

title: Los bancos y neobancos aceleran su apuesta y patrocinios por la F1
summary: Los bancos y neobancos aceleran su apuesta y patrocinios en torno a la F1 en México.

title: Hackeo a Binance expone la vulnerabilidad financiera ante fallos internos y dependencias externas: Expertos
summary: Según ISACA, el hackeo a Binance es una advertencia para todo el sistema financiero: por robusta que sea la tecnología blockchain, las vulnerabilidades pueden estar en fallos internos y dependencias externas.

title: ¿Vas a comprar tu casa? Guía para reunir el dinero de tu enganche y no morir en el intento
summary: El 55% de los mexicanos que rentan cree que nunca podrá comprar casa, por los altos precios y los ingresos requeridos para un crédito hipotecario. El artículo ofrece una guía para reunir el enganche.

title: Nasdaq 100 Set to Enter Correction as Spending Fears Roil Market
summary: The Nasdaq 100 is set to enter correction territory, down 10% from its Oct. 6 record. Worries about AI spending are colliding with disappointing core-business earnings at big tech.

title: América Latina recibe más inversión extranjera, pero caen los anuncios de nuevos proyectos: UNCTAD
summary: La inversión extranjera directa hacia América Latina y el Caribe subió 15% en el primer semestre de 2026, pero cae el valor de los nuevos proyectos anunciados, según la UNCTAD.

title: Google’s $500bn bloodbath reflects the danger it faces from AI
summary: The Economist links Alphabet's roughly $500bn market-value drop to the threat AI poses to its search business, as rivals gain ground while search sputters.

title: What killed Weil Gotshal?
summary: Partners at Weil Gotshal were stunned that a profitable 95-year-old firm with 1,200 lawyers could be felled by a string of departures. The FT examines what killed it.

title: Ignore AI and ask for that pay rise
summary: The Economist argues that fear of an AI revolution may be suppressing wages, and that workers should not let it stop them asking for a pay rise.

title: Weil’s collapse and the death of corporate loyalty
summary: The Economist says Weil's collapse shows the death of corporate loyalty: superstar talent is alluring but also dangerous.
